integrity: The proof derives every adjacency directly from the generalized-dihedral multiplication law and the cyclic subgroup generated by a rotation or by the product of two reflections. The packaged replay reconstructs the center, every pair-generated subgroup, the full graph, degrees, edge count, and noncyclic join form for six independent finite examples.
scientific_limitations: The generalized-dihedral kernel is finite abelian of odd order.
The theorem does not cover even-order kernels, where central involutions and commuting reflections change the graph.
The theorem is an exact family classification, not a classification of all finite groups with a given non-commuting non-generating graph.
title: Exact non-commuting non-generating graphs of odd generalized dihedral groups
